item.title: Windows POS 1.0.41+61
item.description:
Windows POS 1.0.41+61
- Automatically save inventory checks to this PC's local database, separately for each store. Preserve unconfirmed orders, scans, exceptions, Pay & Pickup corrections, and completion state across screen navigation and app restarts. - Restore the existing check when reopening it. Add newly stored orders to the unconfirmed list without clearing prior scans; flag changed order records for review. - Add Refresh stored orders for checks kept open across days. Record and display the check start time and scan timestamps, including on printed reports. - Keep the saved check until New check is explicitly confirmed. Display local save failures and allow retry without silently discarding the in-memory check. - Retain all functionality from 1.0.41+60, including inventory printing, Pay & Pickup corrections, native speech, and Dropoff storage-location editing.
Saved checks are local to this PC and store. Checks from older versions that were already closed cannot be recovered retroactively.
